facts.value: Xuanzang records a tradition that five hundred merchants bought the site for ten koti of gold pieces and gave it to the Buddha.
facts.quote: Five hundred merchants bought it for ten
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://archive.org/download/buddhist-records-of-the-western-world-vol-2/Buddhist%20Records%20of%20the%20Western%20World-Vol%202_djvu.txt' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'Five hundred merchants bought it for ten'

facts.value: Xuanzang says monks who could not discuss questions from the Tripitaka were little esteemed and hid for shame.
facts.quote: are obliged to hide themselves for shame
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://archive.org/download/buddhist-records-of-the-western-world-vol-2/Buddhist%20Records%20of%20the%20Western%20World-Vol%202_djvu.txt' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'are obliged to hide themselves for shame'

facts.value: Xuanzang says the discussions at Nalanda ran from morning till night and the day was not long enough for the questions and answers.
facts.quote: The day is not sufficient for asking and answering profound questions
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://archive.org/download/buddhist-records-of-the-western-world-vol-2/Buddhist%20Records%20of%20the%20Western%20World-Vol%202_djvu.txt' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'The day is not sufficient for asking and answering profound questions'

facts.value: Xuanzang says a stranger who wanted to join the debates first met the keeper of the gate, who set hard questions. Many could not answer and left.
facts.quote: the keeper of the gate proposes some hard questions; many. are unable to answer, and retire
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://archive.org/download/buddhist-records-of-the-western-world-vol-2/Buddhist%20Records%20of%20the%20Western%20World-Vol%202_djvu.txt' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'the keeper of the gate proposes some hard questions'

facts.value: Xuanzang gives the priests at Nalanda as several thousand. It is a traveller's round figure, not a count.
facts.quote: The priests, to the number of several thousands, are men of the highest ability and talent.
facts.check: curl -sL -A 'Mozilla/5.0' 'https://archive.org/download/buddhist-records-of-the-western-world-vol-2/Buddhist%20Records%20of%20the%20Western%20World-Vol%202_djvu.txt' | perl -0pe 's/<[^>]*>/ /g;s/\s+/ /g' | rg -o -m1 -F 'The priests, to the number of several thousands'
